title: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent in Power Systems
summary: China Southern Power Grid's AI company reports that its Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent outperformed human dispatchers in control evaluations on a regional grid.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. developed a flow-control agent for power dispatch. Human dispatchers adjust generation by experience, with decisions taken at the scale of minutes. The developer reports that the agent is deployed in the southwestern Chinese regional power grid, where it adjusts generation outputs in real time. It reports that the agent outperformed human dispatchers in comprehensive control evaluations. It also states that decisions can move to the scale of seconds. Development of the agent continues. The account provides no independent verification of this gain. Energy and emissions benefits remain unquantified.
purpose: Optimize power dispatch while maintaining transmission and stability constraints.
system: Intelligent Transmission Section Flow Control Agent
developer: China Southern Power Grid Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd.
